title: Tip Logging Missing Shift Days
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tiplog:shift
| search shift_logged="true"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by job_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which jobss have gone quiet for tip logging.
value: A missing shift day means the cash and tax picture is already getting fuzzier than it should be.
implementation: Send tip logging events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of jobss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which jobss have gone quiet longer than they should for tip logging.
